responsibility: Contains the top-level drivers and shared orchestration code for GCC’s tree vectorizers: loop vectorization, loop-aware SLP, and basic-block SLP. This file owns common global state such as dump locations, shared cost-dump formatting, SIMD-clone and simduid bookkeeping, vector cost comparison logic for choosing among loop vectorization alternatives and epilogues, and the high-level pass coordination that invokes the more specialized loop, statement, data-reference, pattern, and SLP components.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation side of the tree vectorizer interface from tree-vectorizer.h: top-level pass drivers, shared global state such as vect_location, dump formatting, simduid bookkeeping, and cost-comparison routines. Unlike the header, it is the orchestration and executable logic file rather than the common type-and-helper declaration surface.
